overview:
I'm a radiochemist with experience working with broad variety of radiopharmaceutical platforms - small molecules, biomolecules, and nano- and microparticles. Currently, my group uses molecular imaging techniques, such as PET and SPECT, to understand the biodistribution and health effects of micro- and nanoplastic pollution in mammalian systems.

I obtained my PhD in radiopharmaceutical chemistry from the University of Helsinki in 2018 (thesis supervisors: Drs. Anu Airaksinen and Mirkka Sarparanta). After which I moved to New York to join Dr. Brian M. Zeglis’ laboratory at Hunter College of the City University of New York (2018-2023). I joined UAB Chemistry Department in August 2023 as an assistant professor.
